title: Engine adapter: open-jev-deberta-v3-large (0.4B)
description: Apache-2.0, probabilities per option, CPU and CUDA; MPS not stated. Encoder-based like Laya.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: open-jev-deberta-v3-large answers a scored task

Scenario: The encoder-based comparator returns option probabilities
  Given the open-jev-deberta-v3-large (0.4B, Apache-2.0) encoder model runnable on CPU and CUDA
  When I run bd run --engine open-jev-deberta-v3-large on a committed task
  Then it returns a probability per option for every item, in the same encoder-based shape as Laya, and studies/ records the answers

right_now_summary: The adapter is being added to return option probabilities on CPU and CUDA and record task answers.
